_readme: Random generation pools for generic characters, plus a few lists of flavor.
races.json can carry its own names (angel, android) which take precedence over this file; angel/android lists here are the fallback. android 'l' entries are model designations.

names: first (f) and last (l) names per race; every race has an l list (last names, house names or titles like 'of the Ninth Circle'). Beastkin subs in races.json can add their own l list (names.l), used instead of these half the time. builds/hairStyles/hairColors/eyes/skins/demonSkins/features: appearance picks for image prompts. Builds are extra nuance only (lithe, graceful...): height, figure and bust come from body.json, so don't repeat them here or in a character's design.build.
hooks: why she came to Hollowmere (used in AI backstories). gifts: what Sam gives when he buys a gift. clients: how anonymous clients are described in reports, per client class.
featureGear: generic features that are worn items (only in pictures where she's dressed). featureSkip: features that can't be seen, left out of image prompts (still used in text).
